// Fixture for audit_test.sh: code that resembles Relica patterns but is not
// one. The audit must report nothing here. Not compiled.
package handler

import (
	"github.com/coregx/relica"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

type Handler struct{ db *relica.DB }

// Echo's Context.QueryParams is not Relica's removed Query.QueryParams.
func (h *Handler) List(c echo.Context) error {
	_ = c.QueryParams()
	return nil
}

// The Model API takes column names and always uses the primary key: no Where,
// even when an unrelated chain below reaches Execute().
func (h *Handler) Rename(u *User) error {
	if err := h.db.Model(u).Update("name"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := h.db.NewQuery("ANALYZE users").Execute()
	return err
}

func (h *Handler) RenameVar(u *User) error {
	mq := h.db.Model(u)
	if err := mq.Update("name"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := h.db.NewQuery("ANALYZE users").Execute()
	return err
}

type User struct {
	ID   int    `db:"id"`
	Name string `db:"name"`
}

func (User) TableName() string { return "users" }
